We analyze several representative automatic metrics, with additional results in Appendix E on 50 automatic metric variants. We focus the metric evaluation on ACU annotations because of two insights from §5: (1) Reference-based metrics should be evaluated with reference-based human evaluation. (2) ACU protocol provides higher statistical power than the summary-level Ref-based protocol.

Annotators are presented with atomic content units (ACUs) and asked to mark whether each ACU is present in the candidate summary; in other protocols they rate summaries on a 1‑5 scale.
Annotators are asked to check for the presence of atomic content units (ACUs) in system-generated summaries given reference summaries, and to rate summaries on a 1-5 scale for other protocols.
